WorkoutLog.title: WorkoutLog
WorkoutLog.description: A recorded rehabilitation training session and pain monitoring entry for an athlete.

id.description: Unique identifier for the workout log entry.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who created the entry.

athleteId.description: The athlete this workout belongs to.

sessionName.description: Name or routine title of the completed workout session.

date.description: ISO format date string of the session (YYYY-MM-DD).

prePainScore.description: Pain or tightness score from 0 to 10 before starting the workout.

postPainScore.description: Pain or tightness score from 0 to 10 immediately after completing the workout.

exercisesCompleted.description: List of completed exercise names in the session.

notes.description: Symptom feedback, kinetic observations, or athlete notes.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

AthleteSettings.title: AthleteSettings
AthleteSettings.description: User preferences and current active athlete selection.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when settings were last modified.

/workout_logs/{logId}.description: Collection of recorded rehabilitation sessions for both Arwel and Helen.

/athlete_settings/{userId}.description: User settings and preferences for training phase and selected runner.
